wu: Music Opinions Charades: Students draw cards with music genres (e.g., rap, rock, pop) and act them out while others guess. The actor says 'I think this music is...' after guessing.
wuAlt: Quick poll: 'Stand if you like rap, pop, or traditional music.' Students say 'I like...' or 'I don't like...'
Music Bingo: Call out genres, students cross them off and say 'I think [genre] is...' when they get a line.
pres: Show 3 flashcards with opinion adjectives (exciting, boring, relaxing). Model sentences: 'I think rap is exciting because it has strong beats.' Check understanding by asking 'Why do you think pop is boring?'
presAlt: Play 10-second song clips, students hold up flashcards (exciting/boring/relaxing) and say 'I think this is...'
Read a short review together, underline the 'I think... because' phrases.
prac: Find the Match: Pair students, give them 5 genre cards and 5 reason cards (e.g., 'because it's fast', 'because it's calm'). They match them and say 'I think [genre] is... because...'.
pracAlt: Opinion Relay: Teams race to write 'I think [genre] is...' on the board with a correct reason.
Sentence Builder: Use word cards to make sentences like 'I think jazz is... because...'.
ls: Listen to 2 short song reviews (KET-style). Students note the opinion words and reasons in a table. Check answers by replaying and pausing at key phrases.
re: Genre Jump: Teacher calls out genres, students jump to the corner labeled 'exciting', 'boring', or 'relaxing' and say 'I think [genre] is... because...'.
prod: Pair Interview: Students ask each other 'What music do you like? Why?' Then report to class: 'My partner, [name], thinks [genre] is... because...'.
rw: Read a short KET-style review about a Moroccan singer. Underline all 'I think... because' phrases. Then write 3 sentences about a song they know using the same structure.
st: Play the song 'Lamma Bada Yatathanna' (a traditional Arabic song). Discuss opinions using today's language. Close with 'Today we learned to give opinions about music. Great job, everyone!'
g: Students mark off 'I think... because' sentences called out by the teacher.
Students act out a genre while others guess using 'I think this is... because...'
Teams race to write 3 reasons why they like/dislike a genre.
Sort genre cards into 'exciting', 'boring', 'relaxing' with reasons.
Survey classmates about music tastes and report findings using 'I think... because...'
diff: Fast finishers: Write a 4-sentence review of a song from a Moroccan festival.
Support learners: Use sentence starters like 'I think... is... because...' on a worksheet.
hw: Write a 6-sentence paragraph about your favorite music genre using 'I think... because'.
Record a 30-second audio review of a song, explaining your opinion.
Draw a poster with 3 music genres and your opinions with reasons.
tip: Encourage students to connect music to local festivals like the Gnaoua World Music Festival to build cultural relevance.
